alex (CSM): Heads-up — ThermalCo monthly active API calls down ~48% over the last 14 days vs prior 30d. Renewal in 28 days. :warning:

alex (CSM): Quick snapshot: last 7d avg 2.1k calls/day -> previous 4.0k. No recent product requests logged.

alex (CSM): Query I ran:
```
SELECT date, sum(api_calls) as calls
FROM usage
WHERE account = 'thermalco'
AND date >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 30;
```

tess (AM): Ugh. Who's the procurement contact again? Any contract expansion conversations? :eyes:

alex (CSM): Primary is Maria Chen (Head of ML). Renewal signed Apr 30 2026 (annual). No expansion activity in CRM. Also saw an inbound from a competitor rep on Feb 18 — sales DM thread linked.

ravi (Support): Customer opened a ticket last week about elevated 95p latency on long contexts — shared repro steps. Ticket #12345, status: investigating.

olivia (Product): If latency spikes are causing client-side retries, that would explain the drop. Can you pull model variant + region breakdown for their last ~10k requests?

alex (CSM): On it. Tentative playbook: (1) 30m health check + QBR with Maria + their eng lead; (2) offer 2hr free performance office hours with runtime engineers; (3) escalate support ticket and fast-track any perf fixes. Who can own scheduling? :phone:

tess (AM): I can set the QBR. Proposing Mon Mar 2, 10:00 PT. I'll invite Maria, their Eng Lead, alex, and a rep from acct team.

ravi (Support): Escalation done — eng-runtime looped in. Devs asked for request IDs and full logs; I posted requested scope in ticket.

olivia (Product): I'll assemble a 1-page perf playbook: quick config toggles (batching, KV caching levels, model-variant fallback) and an A/B plan we can run during office hours.

calendar-bot: Scheduled: ThermalCo QBR — Mon Mar 2, 10:00 PT. Invite sent to Maria Chen, ThermalCo Eng Lead, alex (CSM), tess (AM).

alex (CSM): Action items: tess -> schedule QBR (owner), ravi -> escalate ticket (done), olivia -> prepare perf playbook, alex -> collect request-id list + usage query outputs and produce renewal health one-pager by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

tess (AM): Will also directly ask Maria whether they're actively evaluating alternatives and capture rationale.

alex (CSM): I'll draft a renewal health scorecard (usage trend, latency, NPS, exec engagement, contract terms) and share pre-QBR.

ravi (Support): Dropping ticket link and logs in thread for visibility.

alex (CSM): If anyone hears from competitor sales rep or procurement, DM me immediately. Keeping this thread as single-source for triage.

olivia (Product): Thanks — will prioritize rollback-safe config changes and a short test plan for office hours.

alex (CSM): Will follow up with a concise risk assessment doc and recommended commercial mitigations (short-term credits, technical SLO commitments) tomorrow.
